name: The Ridgeway
summary: A vehicle named only in the unlock requirement for the Yesteryear screen filter cheat.
body: PowerPyx and Game Rant say the Yesteryear filter unlocks by discovering the Ridgeway.
DayOne, Press Start, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant spell it Ridgway.
None of these guides says what kind of vehicle it is, which group it belongs to or where it is found.

facts.availability: Location not given in the guides read

name: Martha's Vamos
summary: A named vehicle whose discovery in the Progress menu unlocks the Cataclysm screen filter cheat.
body: PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant and GameSpot all give discovering Martha's Vamos in the Progress menu as the requirement for the Cataclysm cheat.
None of these guides says where the vehicle is found or which standout group it belongs to.

facts.availability: Location not given in the guides read

name: Standout vehicle groups
summary: PowerPyx's count of the 280 standout vehicles in each of 25 groups; no guide read names them individually.
body: PowerPyx counts 19 Ultra-Luxe, 16 Street Racer, 7 Stock Car, 11 Race Bikes, 6 Demolition Derby, 6 Mudder, 5 Donks, 5 Lowriders, 10 Hot Rods, 13 Ripped & Shredded, 20 Retro, 17 All-Terrain and 8 Driveshaft Famous.
It also counts 7 Chopper, 6 Topper, 15 Blinged Up, 16 Girlypop, 12 Patriot, 10 Swamp Style, 30 Leonida Man, 17 Fine Art, 5 Law & Order, 8 Clout Chaser, 6 Pedal Power and 5 Throwback.
PowerPyx's completion guide describes standout vehicles as unique vehicles in fixed locations that do not count toward the 200 base models to be scanned.
The cheat lists from PowerPyx, Press Start, Game Rant, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant say discovering all 16 Girlypop vehicles unlocks the Neon Jungle filter.
No guide read on November 18, 2026 names the individual standout vehicles or gives their locations.
IGN counts 277 regular vehicles and 281 standout vehicles; its group counts match PowerPyx's except Street Racers, where IGN has 17 and PowerPyx 16.

IGN's regular-vehicle split is 18 coupes, 26 muscle cars, 8 off-road, 17 pickups, 29 sedans, 13 sports cars, 9 supercars, 23 SUVs, 14 vans, 29 bikes, 28 watercraft, 16 aircraft, 11 trucks, 9 utility, 7 emergency, 8 military, 6 industrial and 6 transport vehicles.
IGN says 200 vehicles must be discovered for 100 percent, using WAiNK scans.
